text:
sophie: Heads up — the console rollforward consent toggle just went live for a 2% pilot cohort. Need alignment on telemetry tags and quota accounting before we widen this.

raj: Is this opt-in from the tenant side or we flip per-route from console?

sophie: Opt-in from console (admin-level toggle). We add header `X-Redwood-Rollforward: consented` on requests when enabled.

lina: How will billing/quota attribute these calls? We don't want customers surprised by a sudden v2 token delta.

sophie: Plan was: charge against the route's existing quota bucket for now, but emit `v2_rollforward_consent:true` in telemetry so we can split numbers in analytics. No immediate billing migration.

derek: Danger: routing fallbacks still prefer v1 when capacity constrained. If someone consents but we silently route to v1, the telemetry tag will mismatch with actual model served. We need a deterministic tag or a post-Serve tag.

sophie: Good catch. We'll emit two tags: `requested_rollforward:true` on ingress and `served_model:v1|v2` on egress. That should let us reconcile.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollforward-consent toggle v1.0 deployed to prod (canary 2%) :rocket:

emily: What's the revert/runbook if we see latency or cost anomalies? Can we auto-revert the toggle?

raj: Suggest auto-revert rule: if p95 latency on the cohort exceeds baseline by >20% for 10m OR error rate delta >0.5% absolute, flip back and page oncall.

lina: Also add a quota-safety: if per-route token usage grows >30% week-over-week after enabling for a tenant, pause auto-rollforward and surface CTA in console explaining cost impact.

derek: Need console copy for consent — explicitly call out "may route to newer model variants with different token behavior; billing remains on same quota for pilot" and link to telemetry dashboard.

sophie: I'll draft CTA and the dashboard tile. Metrics to expose: `v2_consent_rate`, `requested_vs_served_ratio`, `p95_latency_delta`, `token_delta_weekly`, `rollback_triggers`.

emily: Can we add a small tag in usage CSV export so finance can reconcile? `consent_flag` per row?

sophie: yes — add `consent_flag` and `served_model` columns to exports.

raj: One more ops detail: sampler in routing needs to include cohort membership so we can compute accurate effective throughput. Add `cohort_id` to route logs.

sophie: Agreed. Action items: (1) i18n CTA copy (me), (2) telemetry schema changes + egress tag (raj + lina), (3) dashboard tile + export columns (lina + emily), (4) routing auto-revert rule + runbook (derek). Ramp to 25% after 24h if no triggers.

derek: I'll prototype the auto-revert lambda and smoke tests.

ops-bot: incident-bot: oncall notified if revert auto-trips.

sophie: Perfect. Let's keep the thread for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
